hook.name: MiladyStrategyHook
hook.description: A fixed 20% fee hook for the MLDYSTR/ETH pool that intercepts swaps in afterSwap, takes the fee via afterSwapReturnsDelta, converts token-denominated fees to ETH via a nested poolManager.swap() call, and distributes proceeds 80% to MiladyStrategy and 20% to a protocol fee address. Exact-output swaps are blocked.
